work.name: Squarespace
highlights: Re-architected core email applications into an Rspack-powered React microfrontend using Module Federation and automated localization pipelines, slashing CI/CD build times by 90% (from 30m to 3m) and standardizing cross-repo dependency consumption.

Spearheaded zero-to-one frontend development for a new email service offering and a complete platform redesign targeted to drive $1.5M in revenue and 157k subscribers; built end-to-end onboarding flows from scratch, wired REST APIs, and launched A/B experiments with Product, Design, and Analytics.

Engineered the next-generation link editor for the core website editing engine (serving 590,000+ monthly users) using TypeScript, partnering with UX designers and test engineers to cut visible user latency by over 50%.

Elevated developer experience by engineering local development resource overrides and MFE tooling, drastically reducing local environment setup overhead and enabling seamless multi-repository workflows.

Engineered critical system guardrails to triage and resolve 50% of customer-facing bugs with Customer Support; built client-side state gating and automated Cypress, Jest, and internal E2E testing pipelines.
Onboarded and mentored 3 software engineers, establishing comprehensive system architecture documentation, conducting thorough PR reviews, and presenting microfrontend best practices org-wide.

work.name: Remitly (FinTech)
highlights: Enhanced incident management in an internal dashboard used by over 2,000 developers in 13 offices worldwide using TypeScript (React), GoLang, GraphQL, and Cypher in an agile Developer Experience team.

Implemented a cron job to integrate PagerDuty and Okta data with a React frontend and a Neo4J graph database, optimizing information retrieval and on-call paging processes using TypeScript and Node.js.
Drove end-to-end feature planning and design workflows, prototyping internal dashboard interfaces in Figma, authoring design documentation, and gathering stakeholder feedback.

work.name: Purposer (E-Commerce Start-Up)
highlights: Designed and built many core user journeys for fast-paced e-commerce start-up using TypeScript (React) and MySQL, enabling the MVP launch in ~3 months, with a strong focus on human-centered user experiences.

Implemented core purchasing workflow, enabling users to view and checkout items, track their purchases, process refunds/returns, inventory management, sales throughput, and online storefronts using MaterialUI.
Designed and built seller dashboards for inventory management, sales throughput, and online storefronts using Figma, React Charts, and LeafletJS.
Contributed multiple framework-level React components such as buttons, pop-ups, and tables, allowing other engineering team members to reuse these components in their front-end.
